content.thinking: The regex `RE_NAME = re.compile(_T + r"+[ \t]*:")` has no capture group. I need a group around the name. Let me fix: `re.compile("(" + _T + r"+)[ \t]*:")`.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import re
p=open('submission/gateway.py').read()
p=p.replace('RE_NAME = re.compile(_T + r"+[ \\t]*:")','RE_NAME = re.compile("(" + _T + r"+)[ \\t]*:")')
open('submission/gateway.py','w').write(p)
EOF
grep -n "RE_NAME = " submission/gateway.py && python3 public_check.py submission/gateway.py
